Questions de recherche ouvertes

Ces questions sont des lacunes de recherche consignées, pas des conclusions juridiques.

  • Exact applicability, exceptions and current standing relative to a later policy require authority confirmation. (QA-11-01)
  • A website-only WCAG rule cannot represent kiosks, telecommunications or broadcasting accessibility. (QA-11-02)
  • The terms where possible and where applicable require a published decision process; cannot be reduced to an unconditional Boolean. (QA-25-01)
  • No effective date or triggering enactment confirmed; do not calculate compliance deadlines from publication date. (QA-25-02)
